summary_en: Tender offer purchase target revised to 9,286,037 shares (minimum 3,768,300 shares) at ¥4,790/share. NEC pledged not to tender its CE Holdings shares; EM Systems and Nippon Jiki agreed to tender all holdings. Offer period through 2026-09-30, conditional on shareholder approval of share consolidation.
title_en: Amendment Notice – Change to "Press Release Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer by SK-03 Co., Ltd. for Shares of CE Holdings Co., Ltd. (Code 4320)"
translation_en_brief: SK-03 Co., Ltd. amended the terms of its tender offer for CE Holdings Co., Ltd., which commenced on 2026-08-06. The offeror revised the target share count to 9,286,037 shares (minimum 3,768,300 shares) at a price of ¥4,790 per share, down from the initially announced 10,486,037 shares (minimum 4,968,300 shares). This revision follows execution of agreements with NEC (pledging not to tender its CE Holdings shares), EM Systems (agreeing to tender all holdings), and Nippon Jiki (agreeing to tender all holdings). The offer remains conditional on shareholder approval of a share consolidation, expected to be voted on at an extraordinary general meeting in mid-November 2026. The tender period is scheduled to close on 2026-09-30.
